title: The Armorer
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: The Armorer served as the moral center point for her entire tribe of Mandalorians. Each member looked to her for guidance and as an authority in enforcing his or her strict code of ethics, In addition, The Armorer created the weaponry and armaments used by her Mandalorians. As she had proven many times, she was just as capable in wielding those weapons as she was in forging them.
